ValidationRule.description: Case Reason, Category Lvl3 and Category Lvl4 cannot be empty in a Case. Only exceptions are Default and Useless Cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c ,'US'), RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'NA_Useless', RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'NA_Default', NOT( AND(ISCHANGED(OwnerId),LEFT(PRIORVALUE(OwnerId),3) ='00G') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,"New")), OR( ISPICKVAL(NA1_Category_Level_3__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Reason,'') ), $User.FirstName !='System' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Reason, Category Lvl3 and Category Lvl4 is Mandatory for all Case Types except Useless and Default Cases.
